PDF rendering of the Master List slip for [[Out Of Somewhere (V) (Errata 3)]], front face. It prints the PC-E3 game text (official text as of 27 April 2013), word for word the release-sheet text. The Master List slip prints no slip number.

== References ==
Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List, PDF page 35 ([[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf]]).

Rendered at 300 dpi from the PDF and cropped to the slip (11 November 2026, Batch R8-U5).
